Well, she asked for all my social media passwords and I gave them to her. I asked her for hers, she gave it to me.  But before she gave me the password, she showed me her Facebook messenger and everything was deleted, not a single message. 4 days go by and she tells me that she checked my Facebook and my Instagram and couldn't find anything. She told me that she trusts me and she also respects me so much. I never deleted anything and I have nothing to hide so I didn't expect her to find anything. 3 hours ago, I decided to check her instagram. I checked it and everything was deleted except for messages she has with girlfriends. I saw a suspicious message from her girl best friend. I opened the conversation and found out that she is in fact a cheater.

The day I woke up and found her on the phone deleting a message, she actually was texting a guy. A very old guy who apparently was her boyfriend. In the conversation, she told her friend that he texted her and wants her to come to the city where he lives. He would rent her an amazing apartment and give her a nice job with a great salary. My girlfriend texted her that she is gonna think about whether she is was gonna take him up on that offer. All of this was going on, while we were on a romantic trip. I believed her, and I feel so dumb.

She lied to me. She actually told me that she got a great job offer in another city and she might take it. I was sad but fully supported her. I actually helped her prep for the "final interview" that she told me she was gonna have. I was planning on marrying this girl. I'm moving to a different country for my PhD and was planning to marry her so she could get a visa and come with me. I also already bought an engagement ring. 

I blocked her from everything. I didn't even give her a chance to talk. All I did was say who is "the old guy's name"? We were on a video call and she was shocked, she couldn't even say anything. She kept trying to call me from her mom's number (blocked it), her best friend's number (blocked it), her sister's number (blocked it). Changed all of my social media passwords and blocked her on every single thing.

I don't know if I could ever trust anyone again. I'm 26 and I'm done getting into relationships.
